description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of three language models – Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and an unnamed model – across three categories of answer correctness: Correct, Partially Correct, and Incorrect. The categories are displayed on the horizontal axis, labeled “Correct,” “Partially Correct,” and “Incorrect,” and are arranged in that order. The vertical axis represents the models, labeled “Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B,” “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0,” and a third model with a missing label, and is not sorted in any apparent order. The value axis, which is not explicitly labeled, ranges from 0 to approximately 1, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, the “Correct” bar is dark blue and extends to 0.88, the “Partially Correct” bar is a medium blue and extends to 0.08, and the “Incorrect” bar is light blue and extends to 0.04. For EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, the “Correct” bar is dark blue and extends to 0.96, the “Partially Correct” bar is a medium blue and extends to 0, and the “Incorrect” bar is light blue and extends to 0.04. The third model has a “Correct” bar extending to 0.96, a “Partially Correct” bar extending to 0, and an “Incorrect” bar extending to 0.04. The bars are grouped by model, with each group consisting of three bars representing the three correctness categories, and a legend indicates that dark blue represents “Correct,” medium blue represents “Partially Correct,” and light blue represents “Incorrect.”
